lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT

lines.speaker: header
lines.text: Complaint No. 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: header
lines.text: Page 787 File Number

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And what jacket were you wearing?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn't have a jacket on.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You didn't. What kinda shirt were you wearing? Do you remember?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you remember what shoes you were wearing?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: After you clean up the garage, then what do ya guys do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We take the clothes and we throw, throw them in the fire.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Continue.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then we wait for a little bit then we throw the rest of the stuff on.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What's the rest of the stuff?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The van seat and the cabinet.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Then what do ya do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We wait for it to go down.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What about the jeep? The RAV4? (pause) We, we know certain things happened. But we also don't want you to lie to us or make anything up. What happened to the RAV4?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He took it down in the pit.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did you go with him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Last time you told us you went with him.
